# Keys

## Key lifetime

A signing key lives for 90 days.

## Grace period

The old key keeps working for one hour after a rotation.

Revocation steps
----------------

Revoke a key from the console.

```sh
# Not a heading
echo done
```

## Key lifetime

A second heading with the same text takes a numeric suffix.

## The `key` command and a [link](https://example.com/docs) &amp; more

Inline code keeps its text, and the link keeps its label but not its URL.
